opis: S soncem obsijano grozdje, skrite resnice in trgatev ljubezni v obubožanem vinogradu, kjer se trudijo za dober letnik (in morda ljubezen).
igralci: Susie Abromeit (Allee Balzerini), Tim Ross (Ethan Blake), Cameron Robbie (Nick Balzerini), Jean-Pierre Yerma (Franco Balzerini), Marita Wilcox (Gianna Balzerini), Candice Hill (Catherine Hayes), Matt Domingo (Ben Danson), Mia Grunwald (Sandra), Bianca Zouppas (Lily)
